entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: A Sangrazul Finder brought to Cridhe by Tempé, who caused the Parting and later served Nazir before being devoured by a hungry shroud.

entities.name: Tempé
entities.description: A planeswalker who employed Malvos as a Finder, exiled him to Cridhe, and later demanded the location of the plane's mana.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: A plane almost devoid of mana where Malvos was exiled.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: An enormous hidden source of mana on Cridhe, destroyed in the Parting and later mended.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: A clansman able to do magic whom Malvos used to try to become a planeswalker; the Nohrish take his name.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: A cursed magical firesword won by Tempé from the Thorn, stolen by Malvos, and destroyed when he healed himself.

entities.name: The Parting
entities.description: The destruction of the Clan Tree that split the land and began 520 years of darkness.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: The event after which Malvos was left crippled and abandoned.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Malvos's master among the Nohrish who attempted the Awakening Ritual and fled.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: A young girl brought back by the Nohrish raiding party and run through with Soulslayer by Nazir.

entities.name: Feryar the Fool
entities.description: An elf who confronted Malvos in the chaos at Inys Haen.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: A character who rediscovered Soulslayer and was taught magic by Malvos.

entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: A character who found Soulslayer and passed it on.

entities.name: Arn
entities.description: A character who held Soulslayer briefly.

entities.name: Nohrish
entities.description: The clan led by the Felonarch.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Location where the raiding party failed and where the Awakening Ritual battle took place.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Nohrish land experiencing growing unrest.

entities.name: Ilcae
entities.description: Plane Malvos traveled to and hoped to return to to find other planeswalkers.

entities.name: Parnash
entities.description: Plane Malvos visited with Tempé.

entities.name: Platon
entities.description: A planeswalker Malvos hoped to bargain with.

entities.name: Krim
entities.description: A planeswalker Malvos hoped to bargain with.

entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: The duelist from whom Tempé won Soulslayer.

entities.name: Hungry shroud
entities.description: A magical entity that lured Malvos to sleep and devoured him in the guise of a tent.

entities.name: Sangrazul
entities.description: The people Malvos came from.

events.summary: Malvos steals Tempé's mana as payment and is exiled to Cridhe, marked with snake tattoos that would kill him if he thought of touching mana.
events.quote: Malvos stole Tempé's mana as payment for his services.

events.summary: On Cridhe Malvos discovers the hidden Clan Tree and plans to make someone a planeswalker with its mana.
events.quote: he found an enormous source of mana hidden even from Planeswalkers' eyes

events.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; the magical rays miss the mana line and destroy the Clan Tree, causing the Parting.
events.quote: the Clan Tree was destroyed, causing the Parting

events.summary: In 4064 AR Malvos assists Nazir in investigating the raiding party's failure and in interrogating Aylith.
events.quote: Malvos assisted Nazir in investigating the failure.

events.summary: Malvos goes with Nazir to Inys Haen to force the Awakening Ritual, but Aylith's allies arrive and Nazir flees, leaving Malvos behind.
events.quote: Malvos remained behind to control the situation

events.summary: Malvos grasps Soulslayer when Feryar confronts him; its serpents bite him, he is captured and forced to teach Jedhian, and the blade crumbles.
events.quote: the silver serpents embedded in it came to life, sinking their fangs into his flesh

events.summary: Crippled after the Mending, Malvos is visited by Tempé, tells her what he knows, and is devoured by a hungry shroud.
events.quote: collapsing around him, devouring him whole

relations.note: Promised to teach him to planeswalk
relations.quote: promising to teach him to become a Planeswalker himself

relations.note: Malvos remained at his master's side
relations.quote: refusing to believe his master had abandoned him

relations.note: Malvos stole from Tempé and was exiled by her
relations.quote: He was punished with exile to Cridhe
